evidence.measured_root_cause: e2e/fixtures/helpers.ts:23 getByLabel('Password') is a Playwright SUBSTRING match and resolves to BOTH #register-password (label 'Password') and #register-confirm-password (label 'Confirm password') on /register, so all three specs die in the shared registerUser helper (CI run 38318118545 step 8, SHA 008a8165). The local stack then exposed nine MORE measured defects behind it: register 201 returns UserResponse with no token and auth_context never falls back to login (no session, no redirect); helpers call the fictional page.requestGet (the t27 d.ts gate hid it by declaring it); specs use Food/Transport but seeded rows are Food & Dining/Transportation; getByRole(heading,Budget) hits 3 nodes on /budgets; isolation reads the KPI without refetch; loginUser hangs when already authenticated (login redirects away); happy-path asserts wrong arithmetic against its own inputs; chartSurfaces assumes all five charts are role=img but the heatmap is a div grid and Budget usage is a progressbar (and renders only after a budget is set); the heatmap grid renders at height 0 so toBeVisible fails. Base RED reproduces the CI error exactly; fixture GREEN = 3 passed in 11.9s.
